description: Fix slugify(text): lowercase ASCII letters and digits, replace each run of other characters with one hyphen, and strip leading/trailing hyphens.
visible_tests:
assert slugify('Hello World') == 'hello-world'
assert slugify(' a   b! ') == 'a-b'
oracle_tests:
assert slugify('') == ''
assert slugify('---A...B___C---') == 'a-b-c'
assert slugify(' 123 ') == '123'
assert slugify('!@#') == ''

description: Fix chunks(values, size): return a list of consecutive nonempty list chunks, preserving order and including the last partial chunk. Raise ValueError when size <= 0. Empty input returns [].
initial_source:
def chunks(values, size):
    return [values[i:i+size] for i in range(0, len(values)-size+1, size)]

description: Fix median(values): return the median of a nonempty numeric list, using the mean of the two middle values for even length. Do not mutate the input. Raise ValueError for an empty list.
Fix parse_bool(value): accept strings true/yes/1 and false/no/0, ignoring surrounding whitespace and letter case. Return a boolean. Raise ValueError for any other string.
visible_tests:
assert parse_bool('true') is True
assert parse_bool('false') is False
